name: C3 Development Environment
postAttachCommand: mkdir -p /home/c3dev/.ssh && rm -f /home/c3dev/.ssh/* 2>/dev/null; cp -f /home/c3dev/.host-ssh/* /home/c3dev/.ssh/ 2>/dev/null; chmod 700 /home/c3dev/.ssh; chmod 600 /home/c3dev/.ssh/* 2>/dev/null; true
initializeCommand: docker network inspect devnetwork || docker network create devnetwork
postCreateCommand: node /workspace/.devcontainer/setup-workspace.mjs && mkdir -p /home/c3dev/.vscode-server && ln -sf /workspace/dev.code-workspace /home/c3dev/.vscode-server/dev.code-workspace && git config --global --add safe.directory /host_workspace && git config --global core.autocrlf input
